access.lead: A role granted here applies to this item and everything inside it.

deployments.emptyText: Releases appear here as soon as your CI reports deployments.
deployments.driftHint: A cluster runs a different version than the last deployment.
deployments.tagsLead: Collected documentation of tags, newest first.

events.title: Received events
events.emptyText: Events your CI sends to this project appear here.

howTo.title: How to send events
howTo.lead: Your CI reports each rollout step to this endpoint, authenticated by a project key.
howTo.secrets: Add two settings to your CI: the variable SVCR_URL = {url} and the secret SVCR_PROJECT_KEY = the project key.
howTo.idempotency: Use a unique idempotency_key per rollout step: resending the same event is safe, reusing the key for a different event is rejected.
howTo.stepKey: Issue a project key on the “Keys” tab and copy it — it is shown only once.
howTo.stepSend: Add a step that reports each rollout to the endpoint above:
howTo.links: links is optional: links of this deployment (CI run, release) shown on the project while it is current.

catalog.lead: Organizations, folders and projects you can see.

repoSync.title: Repository sync
repoSync.lead: Import the repositories of a GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo or Gitea owner as projects under this node and keep their metadata current.
repoSync.emptyText: Connect a hosting owner to import its repositories.
repoSync.ownerHint: Organization or user; for GitLab the full group path, e.g. acme/platform.
repoSync.apiUrlHint: Empty for github.com and gitlab.com. Self-hosted: the instance address (GitHub Enterprise: https://host/api/v3).
repoSync.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token.
repoSync.tokenRefHint: env:VARIABLE or file:/absolute/path — the server reads the token there; nothing is stored.
repoSync.patternsHint: Glob patterns separated by commas, e.g. svc-*, *-api.
repoSync.confirmDelete: Delete the connection to {owner}? Its projects stay in the catalog as manual projects.
repoSync.webhookLead: The hosting notifies the registry about pushes and repository changes; scheduled syncs stay as a fallback.
repoSync.registerHint: The token needs administrator rights on the owner.
repoSync.secretOnce: The secret is shown only now. Paste it into the hosting's webhook settings.
repoSync.confirmDisable: Disable the webhook? Deliveries will be refused; scheduled syncs continue.
repoSync.branchIncludeHint: Glob patterns of full branch names separated by commas, e.g. main, release/*; empty — every branch. The default branch is always taken.
repoSync.ownerUrlHint: Web address of the group, organization or user, e.g. https://gitlab.example.com/platform/team — the hosting, owner and API address are filled in from it.

exclusions.title: Excluded repositories
exclusions.empty: No exclusions. A project is excluded with “Unlink from repository sync” on its page.
exclusions.confirm: Remove the exclusion? The project becomes synchronized again on the next run.
exclusions.restored: Exclusion removed; the next sync brings the project back.

repoSync.intervalInheritHint: The node's polling period is used.
repoSync.intervalInherited: The node's polling period: every {n} min
repoSync.paused: Polling is paused in the node's settings

repoMeta.orphanedText: The repository is gone from the hosting (deleted, moved or no longer accessible). The project is no longer synchronized and can be deleted.
repoMeta.readmeFull: Open the full README on the hosting

branches.title: Branches
branches.lead: Branches of the project from the hosting, CI events and the default branch. Gone and idle branches are cleaned up automatically; the default and pinned ones are kept.
branches.confirmDelete: Delete the record of {name}? Deployments of this branch stay; the branch comes back if the hosting or CI shows it again.

links.title: Links
links.lead: Logs, dashboards, errors and other systems of this project, built from templates on it and on the folders and organizations above it.
links.emptyText: Add link templates in the Templates section on this project or on an organization or folder above it.

templates.title: Templates
templates.lead: Link templates in effect here. Inherited ones come from the nodes above; a template here overrides them.

dialog.keyHint: Usually the kind's key; several links of one kind need different keys.
dialog.templateHint: Variables in braces, e.g. project.slug, path, environment, namespace, branch, vars.<name>, labels.<name>; filters |raw and |lower. Values are URL-encoded unless |raw.
dialog.previewEmpty: Enter a template to see the links it gives.
dialog.title: Title
dialog.titleHint: Optional; shown instead of the kind name.
dialog.iconHint: PNG, WebP, ICO or SVG up to 64 KiB.

templates.confirmDelete: Delete the template “{key}” of this node? Inherited templates with this key apply again.

vars.title: Variables
vars.lead: Values for vars.<name> in templates. Inherited ones come from the nodes above.
vars.editHint: key=value; Enter, comma or pasted lines add a variable. Only this node's own variables; inherited ones stay.

links.emptyEvents: Or send links with deployments: the links field of the service.deployed event.

docs.lead: Files collected from the project's documentation source.
docs.partialHint: Some files were not stored: they are too large, not text or over the limits.
docs.truncated: The hosting returned an incomplete file tree.
docs.noFile: Choose a file on the left.

settings.title: Collection settings
settings.lead: Which files and branches of the repository are collected.
settings.refsDuplicate: This pattern is already listed for the same kind.
settings.refsHint: The default branch is always collected. At most {n} newest tags are collected; newer means a larger version in the name. The newest tag matching a pattern marked Release is the project's current release.
settings.refsNoTags: Tags are not collected: the server is configured without tags.
settings.hint: Enter, comma or pasted lines add a pattern: * — any characters except /, ** — any directories, ? — one character, {a,b} — either.
settings.readOnly: Only editors can change these settings.
settings.leadNode: What the projects below collect. Each field is taken from the nearest node that sets it.
settings.includeHint: Empty — only the README at the root.
settings.readmeRule: Only the README at the root
settings.apisHint: Files on the API description paths are collected without the Include patterns, letter case is ignored, and Exclude applies to them too; by default — openapi* in any folder and everything in api-docs/.
settings.refreshEventHint: the selected events queue a collection; without them — only “Collect now”
settings.apiPathsInactive: Not in effect: API descriptions are turned off
settings.refreshEventsEmpty: Collections will run only on “Collect now”
settings.eventClusterDeployedHint: A new version in Kubernetes without a CI event.
settings.eventRepoSyncWebhookHint: A push delivered by a webhook moved a branch head.
settings.eventRepoSyncManualHint: The “Sync” button or repo:sync moved a branch head.

docs.noSource: Documentation needs a source: link the project to repository sync or set a source in the documentation settings.

source.title: Source
source.lead: Where the documentation of this project is collected from.
source.apiUrlHint: Filled in from the repository address; you can change it.
source.tokenHint: Leave empty to keep the stored token.
source.pathHint: An absolute path inside the directories allowed by the server.
source.gitHint: Branches are read from commits; the checked-out branch can also include uncommitted files.
source.confirmRemove: Remove the documentation source? The collected snapshots stay.
source.workingTree: Include uncommitted files of the current branch
source.workingTreeHint: The checked-out branch is read from the working copy: new and edited files are collected, files excluded by .gitignore are not.
source.workingTreeOn: commits and uncommitted files of the current branch
source.includeIgnoredHint: Files matching the include patterns are collected even when git ignores them; other ignored files stay out. Prefer narrow patterns like openspec/**/*.md.
source.includeIgnoredOn: commits, uncommitted and git-ignored files matching the patterns

docs.onlyReadme: Only the README at the root is collected — choose folders in the documentation settings.

viewer.parseFailed: Could not parse the file — shown as text.

gitStatusHint.untracked: Not in the git index — the file is only in the working copy
gitStatusHint.ignored: Ignored by git — the file is collected because of the “collect ignored files” setting

tree.name: Name
tree.label: Label
tree.labelHint: key or key=value, several separated by commas
tree.truncated: The first 500 matches are shown — refine the filter.

about.title: Description
about.markdownHint: Markdown: headings, lists, links, tables, code. HTML is shown as text.

settings.moveText: Move the node and everything inside to another organization or folder.
settings.deleteText: Delete the node. Only an empty node can be deleted.

unlink.title: Unlink from repository sync
unlink.text: Stop synchronizing this project with the hosting and edit it by hand.
unlink.confirm: The repository is added to the connection's exclusions and the project becomes manual. Its documentation source stays a repository by address with the connection's secret. To bring it back, remove the exclusion in the connection dialog.
unlink.noSecret: The connection has no named secret: the new source will have no token.

owners.title: Owners
owners.lead: Groups and people responsible for this node; the first one is the primary owner. Owners set above apply here too and cannot be removed here — you can only add your own.
owners.addPlaceholder: Start typing a group or user name, or pick from the list
owners.readOnly: Only editors of this node can change owners.

dependencies.emptyFolder: There are no dependencies in this folder
dependencies.howTo: Report dependencies in the deployment event, a Kubernetes annotation or the .svc-registry.yaml file.
dependencies.manualLead: Dependencies you add here are kept until you remove them; automatic sources never change them.
dependencies.autoLead: These come from deployment events, cluster annotations and the .svc-registry.yaml file and change only there.
dependencies.removeText: The dependency on {name} will be removed.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.hint: Every signed-in user sees an open organization with all its content. Only people with roles can change it.
visibility.stateOpen: Open — every signed-in user can read it.
visibility.stateClosed: Closed — only people with roles see it.

orgGroups.title: Groups
orgGroups.lead: Groups of this organization get roles and ownership only inside it. Its admins manage them.
orgGroups.empty: The organization has no groups yet.
orgGroups.name: Name
orgGroups.confirmDelete: Delete the group “{name}”? Its roles and ownership in the organization go with it; users stay.
orgGroups.membersHidden: Members are shown to those who manage the organization's groups.
orgGroups.search: Type at least three letters of a name or email
orgGroups.readOnly: Only admins of the organization manage its groups.

publication.title: Publication
publication.lead: Show this documentation without signing in. Each field is taken from the nearest node where it is set.
publication.readOnly: Only holders of the publication right change these settings.
publication.versionsHint: Only collected versions are published. Patterns: * — any characters except /, ** — any.
publication.name: Public name
publication.nameHint: Address /public/docs/<name>: a-z, 0-9 and -, up to 63 characters.
publication.hostHint: Serve this node's public documentation on its own host, e.g. docs.example.com. DNS and TLS are set up outside.
publication.unreachable: Published but has no address: set a public name or publish a parent.

members.title: Members
members.lead: People of the organization. Everyone with access to the organization sees this list.
members.name: Name
members.viaGroupsLead: Global groups with roles in the organization; their people see it without being members.
members.removeText: Their roles in the organization, ownership of its nodes and membership in its groups are taken away. Access through global groups stays.
members.findHint: Name or email, at least 3 characters

mail.disabled: Mail is not set up — pass the link on yourself.
mail.failed: The letter was not sent — pass the link on yourself.

polling.title: Repository polling
polling.lead: How often and how long the registry polls repositories here. Each field is taken from the nearest node where it is set; otherwise the server defaults apply.
polling.readOnly: Only editors of the node change these settings.
polling.intervalHint: From {min} to {max} minutes. Applies to repository sync, documentation and skills alike.
polling.timeoutHint: From {min} to {max} seconds for one request to the hosting.
polling.applies: These settings apply to repository sync and to documentation collection of the projects below.
polling.appliesOrganization: These settings apply to repository sync, documentation collection and the git sources of the organization's skills.
polling.offHint: With «Do not poll» only manual runs go to the repositories: sync now, collect now, sync a source.
polling.publishedHint: «Only published documentation» stops collecting projects whose documentation is not published; collected snapshots stay.
polling.invalid: Enter a whole number in the range.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: There is no page at this address. It may have been moved, or the link is mistyped.

search.title: Documentation search
search.lead: Search the documentation of every project you can read.

scans.title: Scan history
scans.lead: Recent documentation collection and search indexing runs of every project, with what went wrong and what to do.
scans.emptyText: Runs appear here once documentation collection or search indexing runs for a project.

no_files_matched.title: No file matched the collection patterns
no_files_matched.text: The branch was read, but none of its files fit the include patterns, so the snapshot is empty.
no_files_matched.hint: Check the include and exclude patterns on the Documentation settings tab of the project or its folder.
no_files_matched.hintGit: A local git source reads only committed files: commit the documentation (git add + commit) or check the include patterns.

files_skipped.title: Some files were skipped
files_skipped.text: Files that match the patterns were not stored: too large, binary or over the file limit.
files_skipped.hint: Raise KNOWLEDGE_MAX_FILE_BYTES / KNOWLEDGE_MAX_FILES or exclude these files.

truncated.title: The repository tree was truncated
truncated.text: The hosting returned only part of the file tree, so some files may be missing.
truncated.hint: Narrow the include patterns or collect from a smaller repository.

no_branches.title: No branch to collect
no_branches.text: The source answered, but no branch matches the default branch or the branch patterns.
no_branches.hint: Set the project's default branch or add a pattern under Branches on the Documentation settings tab.

no_source.title: The project has no documentation source
no_source.text: There is neither a documentation source nor a repository sync, so there is nothing to collect.
no_source.hint: Set a source on the Documentation settings tab → Source, or connect the folder to repository sync.

manifest_invalid.title: The project description file was not read in full
manifest_invalid.text: The .svc-registry.yaml file of the default branch is larger than 64 KiB, is not valid YAML or lists dependencies that are not valid references, so some dependencies were not taken.
manifest_invalid.hint: Fix the file in the repository: dependencies must be a list of project paths or external:<name> references.

not_found.title: The directory or repository is missing
not_found.text: Nothing exists at the source path or address.
not_found.hint: Check the path or address of the source; restore the directory if it moved.

not_a_repository.title: No git repository at the path
not_a_repository.text: The path exists, but it is not a git repository.
not_a_repository.hint: Point the source at the repository root or switch it to a local directory.

unreadable.title: The source cannot be read
unreadable.text: The registry has no access to the files (permissions, a broken repository).
unreadable.hint: Check the file permissions of the server process and the repository state.

not_allowed.title: The path is outside the allowed roots
not_allowed.text: Local sources are allowed only inside KNOWLEDGE_LOCAL_ROOTS.
not_allowed.hint: Move the documentation under an allowed root or extend KNOWLEDGE_LOCAL_ROOTS.

credentials_unavailable.title: The access token is unavailable
credentials_unavailable.text: The stored token cannot be decrypted or the env:/file: reference does not resolve.
credentials_unavailable.hint: Enter the token again or check SECRETS_KEYS and the referenced variable or file.

unauthorized.title: The hosting rejected the token
unauthorized.text: The token is invalid, expired or lacks rights to the repository.
unauthorized.hint: Issue a token with read access to the repository and save it in the source or connection.

not_found.title: The repository was not found on the hosting
not_found.text: The hosting does not know the repository or hides it from the token.
not_found.hint: Check the address and that the token can see the repository.

owner_not_found.title: The hosting owner was not found
owner_not_found.text: The organization, group or user of the connection does not exist or is hidden.
owner_not_found.hint: Check the owner path of the repository sync connection.

rate_limited.title: The hosting rate limit is exhausted
rate_limited.text: Too many API requests; the next run waits for the limit to reset.
rate_limited.hint: Use a token with a higher limit or collect fewer branches.

upstream_error.title: The hosting or storage failed
upstream_error.text: The hosting answered with an error or the snapshot could not be saved.
upstream_error.hint: Look at the technical details; the run is retried automatically.

embeddings_unavailable.title: The embeddings API is unavailable
embeddings_unavailable.text: The embeddings API did not answer or answered with an error; the files stay queued.
embeddings_unavailable.hint: Check EMBEDDINGS_URL, EMBEDDINGS_MODEL and that the model server (e.g. Ollama) is running.

embeddings_dimensions.title: Wrong embedding size
embeddings_dimensions.text: The model returns vectors of a different length than EMBEDDINGS_DIMENSIONS.
embeddings_dimensions.hint: Set EMBEDDINGS_DIMENSIONS to the model's native size (see the technical details).

engine_unavailable.title: The search engine is unavailable
engine_unavailable.text: Qdrant, Meilisearch or the vector extension did not answer.
engine_unavailable.hint: Check QDRANT_URL / MEILISEARCH_URL and that the engine is running.

engine_dimensions.title: Collection dimensions do not match the model
engine_dimensions.text: The search engine collection stores vectors of another length than EMBEDDINGS_DIMENSIONS.
engine_dimensions.hint: Set another QDRANT_COLLECTION or recreate the collection (see the technical details), then restart the service.

internal.title: Internal error
internal.hint: Look at the technical details and the server log.

scans.projectLead: Documentation collection and indexing runs of this project: result, branches, errors and what to do about them.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.nodeIntro: Tokens and access keys of this node. Repository sync connections and documentation sources here and below pick them; values are not shown after saving.
secrets.globalIntro: Global secrets are available to every node and cluster. Values are not shown after saving.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.descriptionHint: Everyone who can read the node sees the description.
secrets.deleteText: The secret will be deleted permanently.
secrets.inUse: Used in {n} places — replace it there first.
secrets.unreadable: The secret is not available without the right to read secrets.

docSpace.title: Documentation
docSpace.lead: Documentation of every project, by space and folder.
docSpace.notCollectedText: Nothing has been collected for this project yet.
docSpace.noMarkdown: This project has no Markdown files; pick a file in the contents.
docSpace.chooseSpaceHint: Choose a space to see its folders and projects.

oauth.title: Allow access to the registry
oauth.unverified: The registry has not verified this application.
oauth.returnTo: After your decision you will be sent to
oauth.accessText: Use the registry's MCP server on your behalf: read projects, documentation, deployments and links that you can see.
oauth.stale: The request is out of date — start connecting in the app again.
oauth.publishedOn: The app's description is published on
oauth.loopbackWarning: The answer goes back to this computer. Any program running on it could pretend to be this app — allow only if you started the connection yourself.
oauth.hintHosts: As an administrator: if you trust this app, add {host} to MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_HOSTS and restart the server.
oauth.hintDisabled: As an administrator: app description documents are turned off. Set MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA=on and add {host} to MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_HOSTS to accept this app.
oauth.hintUnavailable: As an administrator: the app description document could not be fetched from {host}: {reason}.
oauth.hintInvalid: As an administrator: the app description document on {host} failed the checks: {reason}.

reasons.timeout: the server did not answer in 5 seconds
reasons.dns: the host name does not resolve
reasons.tls: the TLS certificate is not trusted or the TLS handshake failed
reasons.blocked_address: the address is forbidden by the address policy (private, loopback or denied host)
reasons.redirect: the server answered with a redirect, redirects are not followed
reasons.too_large: the document is larger than 5 KiB
reasons.rate_limited: too many document fetches from your address, try again later
reasons.not_json: the document is not a JSON object
reasons.client_id_mismatch: client_id in the document differs from its address
reasons.bad_redirect_uri: redirect_uris are missing or not allowed
reasons.grant_types: grant_types hold something besides authorization_code and refresh_token

gateway.title: MCP servers
gateway.none: No external servers will be available.
gateway.hint: Only the chosen servers are available.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.lead: Where events of this node and everything inside are sent: a webhook or Slack. A subscription set above applies here too until it is overridden or disabled.
notify.emptyText: Add a webhook or a Slack channel to hear about deployments, drift, broken links and failed repository syncs.
notify.removeText: Notifications of this subscription stop here. A subscription with the same key above takes effect again.

dialog.keyHint: a-z, 0-9 and -, unique on the node
dialog.secretHint: The secret holds the webhook address; for Slack an https://hooks.slack.com/ incoming webhook.
dialog.environmentsHint: Empty — all environments. Broken links and repository sync failures have no environment and always pass.
dialog.disabledHint: A disabled subscription receives nothing and switches off the one with the same key above.

signing.title: Signing key
signing.none: No signing key: requests are not signed.
signing.once: Copy the key now: it is not shown again. Receivers check webhook-signature with it.

test.tooOften: Too often, try again in {n} s

journal.title: Delivery log
journal.lead: Deliveries of this node's subscriptions, newest first.

notify.http_status: The receiver answered with an error
notify.timeout: The receiver did not answer in time

page.author: Author

policy.overrideHint: A skill can override each field.

settings.publicationDraft: A draft is seen only by those who can change the skill.
settings.publicationPublished: Published: readers and agents see the skill.
